counts: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; 0 online trophies
sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all 55. Guide text is written for this guide in its own words; each trophy names the guide it draws on. Where the early guides have not confirmed a method, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan the run around A Long Road (100% completion), which is the longest grind of the set.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, so it unlocks within the first hour. Nothing to plan or prepare.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 by playing the main missions in order. Do the one missable meditation in this chapter first (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 by playing the main missions in order. The name is masked with asterisks on PlayStation itself — that is how the official list prints it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 by playing the main missions in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 by playing the main missions in order.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission (the Chapter 5 finale). After the story you stay in free-roam, so nothing is locked behind it — but there is no mission replay, so finish the story before starting cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it comes up in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy of the set (PowerPyx). The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats — but progress made during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly. After the finale, open the checklist and work through it line by line; most of the other trophies fall out of it on the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in total — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps — so you only need about two-thirds of them. Stunts count as you play and the in-game stats track them, so mop up the easy ones (ramps and jumps near roads) during cleanup.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try at each is enough — do them as you pass them rather than hunting them down in one trip.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Gold each challenge; the ranges sit across Leonida, so tick them off as you travel instead of saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in all. Win one race at each spot; you do not need to win every race a location offers.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count — repeat wins at the same event do not add to it, so keep moving to new events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so you will meet it while working on Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game — finishing one game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs alongside the story; his final mission unlocks late. Every trophy-related quest giver stays available in free-roam after the story, so this cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story, but he returns — keep checking back, and finish his strand in free-roam if it is still open after the finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's mission strand runs alongside the story; finish his last mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish eight full strands. Some optional missions expire after a while, but the trophy needs eight strands and there are more than eight available.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's mission strand runs alongside the story; finish his last mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's mission strand runs alongside the story; finish his last mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all. THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, then walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. She shows you how to meditate. That meditation raises the counter in the Progress menu by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. After Chapter 1 it is gone for good. The other spots are marked on the map.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a unique animal — track it down and hunt it. Hunting is also one of the nine activity types, so it counts toward Master of None as well.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total, so finish any three. Cards are found across Leonida — pick them up as you explore rather than hunting all of them in one trip.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — 100 scans. Scanning a new vehicle also counts toward discovering it (Whip It Good), so scan everything you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, so finish any 50. Challenges cover the game's activities, so they stack up naturally while you work through the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Play with your partner, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star level, so pair this with Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time — plan a route of three nearby shops and keep moving between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough to count a vehicle, so scan every new vehicle you see — parked, driving past, anything. It stacks with You WAiNKer! if you scan as you go.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before a fight, fill your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. Pick a fight with at least five enemies grouped together, then trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description is deliberately vague and the early guides are still pinning down the exact trigger — the working lead is to leave the airport by an unscheduled route, in a stolen aircraft, rather than through the normal exit. If it does not pop on the first try, try a different aircraft and departure direction.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at Rhino tanks: get into a tank encounter — steal a Rhino or take one on — and the trophy should pop. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the early guides, so treat this as the lead rather than a verified method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and get out unseen. If you are spotted, leave and try again — being detected fails the attempt, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. A vault robbery instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level, so it pairs with Hot Together — escape the heat after each vault and both trophies move together.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, take the cash and escape the wanted level that follows.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map; the game tracks what you have seen. Drive the whole state during cleanup and the last few areas will fill in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. One illegal operation per gang, nine robberies in total. Work through the gangs one by one during cleanup.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The lead is the description itself: order a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach and enjoy it. This is one of five hidden trophies whose exact unlock is still unconfirmed by the early guides — if the cocktail does not pop it, try different Ocean Beach bars and times of day.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's frontage and out the other side. Still unconfirmed by the early guides — the description is the lead, so try a fast car and a straight line through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — a full game of bowling there. Bowling is one of the activities, so it also feeds into Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time — train both characters' strength to the maximum together and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the profile tracks your choices across the game, so keep making profile-affecting choices and the count builds up on its own over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Retry something and succeed on the second attempt. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the early guides — the description is the only lead so far, so expect it to pop naturally on a second-try success.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — most likely a UFO-style easter egg event out in Leonida. Still unconfirmed by the early guides; keep an eye out for strange events while exploring, especially at night in remote spots.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the early guides — try a slow drive-by with a bat or similar melee weapon.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Sell marked bills to your contacts until $250,000 is laundered in total — it accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Total spending across every shop counts; big purchases such as vehicles and property get there fastest. It stacks with Little Boxes if you buy garage properties.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage property on the market. Property purchases also count toward the $100,000 spending in Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles in the app — the ones you discover for Whip It Good are the obvious candidates.
